<thought>Based on the observed isotope pattern, a clear M+1 peak (~10 % of the base peak) is present, which is characteristic of the natural ¹³C abundance and indicates the presence of carbon. No other element shows a definitive isotopic signature (e.g., the expected 3:1 M:M+2 ratio for chlorine or ~1:1 for bromine is absent). Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
